description: After spending three hundred years fighting demons in another world, Leon Dragonia Lionheart finally returns to Earth. But he does not return alone—the gods who supported him throughout his long battle have followed him back. Now Earth is plagued by monster gates and dungeons, and Leon must use his overwhelming strength, divine powers, and centuries of experience to protect humanity while rebuilding his legendary knightly order.
author: Jidaegong Mabeobsonyeon / Salam Sallyeo / Jeoncheon Huma Geomsa
